name: MSRC Glossary
description: Microsoft Security Response Center (MSRC) Glossary — vendor-published glossary of ~133 security terms used across Microsoft security advisories, CVE disclosures, and product security documentation. Maintained by the MSRC team.
relationToCloudSecurity: Indirect — Microsoft-product-centric terminology, but covers identity (AD FS, Azure AD), authorization, and cloud-relevant primitives.
relationToAISecurity: Includes AI-specific entries (AI Bug Bar, AI Safety) reflecting MSRC's expanding coverage of AI vulnerability disclosure.

license.notes: Microsoft copyright. The glossary page states no open licence; its footer links Microsoft's terms of use (checked 2026-11-14). The public copy here rests on the 4-tier hosting rule, not on a licence from the publisher. Publicly accessible web resource with no login required (Tier 2 of Kurt Seifried 2026-11-09 4-tier hosting rule: open-web no-login content is mirrored in the public dataset repository with attribution).
